integrity: The exact value is proved analytically by symmetry reduction and a complete one-variable minimax analysis. Decimal values are checks only and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the two-dimensional mixed-power Luxemburg ball with exponents 3/2 and 3. It does not classify all cross-Hilbert exponent pairs or higher-dimensional Musielak--Orlicz spaces.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance of the \((3/2,3)\) mixed-power Luxemburg plane
